title: review_verdict
description: Sub-call output contract for ONE adversarial verifier in the multi-agent REVIEW workflow (#73): the verdict on a single deduped finding the verifier was asked to refute with evidence from the working tree.

fingerprint.description: the _issue_fingerprint of the finding under verification — how the engine's fold matches this verdict back to its finding. An unmatchable fingerprint leaves the finding confirmed (fail toward blocking).

verdict.description: `confirmed`: the verifier could not kill the finding — it blocks. `refuted`: the verifier disproved it with evidence — the fold demotes it to non_blocking (prefixed `refuted:`), never silently erased.

reasoning.description: the evidence for the verdict — for a refutation, why it does not hold; surfaced with the finding so an adversary can't silently erase a real issue
